questions.question: What motivated you to go on exchange? (pick the most important one) *
Which aspects were crucial to choosing your study destination? *
questions.answer: I chose Oslo because I had previously visited the city and liked it a lot. Also, the fact that astounding nature is just outside the city was really appealing.

questions.question: How would you rate your overall study abroad experience? *
Additional comments:
How easy was it to find the information you needed to know upon arrival? *
What assistance, if any, did you receive when you arrived at your study destination? *
questions.answer: We had intro-buddys who did social things with us and told us who to contact if we had any technical or study-related problems.

questions.question: Overall, how satisfied were you with the orientation and assistance available to students at your host institution upon arrival? *
Additional comments
How did you find housing? *
questions.answer: I found housing through my host institution

questions.question: Did you live on campus or off campus? *
How easy was it to find off campus housing? Any recommendations? *
questions.answer: It was very easy, as Oslo has a student organization called SiO (Student in Oslo) which administrates the student housing.

questions.question: What should future exchange students know about living off campus? *
questions.answer: Apply to live in Sogn - there is a student bar where a lot of the exchange students hang out, and where you can meet lots of people.

questions.answer: There wasn't really any registration process. I just applied at my home university, and then that was it.

questions.answer: Norwegians are more nature-oriented than Danish peopleq

questions.answer: It's expensive, so prepare to use a lot of money. Go see the nature. Go see the rest of Norway.
